parsed.answer: Source 16472469 explicitly identifies pyridostatin (PDS) as a "G4-stabilizing compound" and states that G-quadruplex (G4)-forming genomic sequences include telomeres. It further reports that PDS treatment increases telomere fragility in BRCA2-deficient cells, consistent with PDS stabilizing telomeric G-quadruplexes and thereby driving telomere instability. The remaining sources concern bone homeostasis and IL-2 autoimmunity and are irrelevant to the claim.
